owner_creation.analysis: The closequote c_char owns a closing-quote byte initialized to double quote; -c copies a character and -d copies a parsed number.
owner_creation.invariant: Closing quote is owned inline in static storage.
limitations: closequote owns one terminating quote byte independent of argument data.

aliases_escapes.analysis: Only a copied byte survives parsing; printf receives closequote's integer promotion rather than a borrowed pointer into argv.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Closing quote cannot dangle when argv changes.
limitations: A copied closing delimiter cannot validate the input string lifetime.

callback_targets.analysis: Quoted-output dispatch is a direct printf call using %c; the closequote field is not a registered native callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Closing quote is interpreted only as a character.
limitations: Output calls do not register a target in closequote.

invalidation.analysis: Option replacement changes the closequote byte in place before output starts; no heap owner or string alias is invalidated.
invalidation.invariant: Quote updates do not replace storage.

mutation_commit.analysis: The -d branch assigns closequote and exits on missing numeric input; only completed option parsing reaches output.
mutation_commit.invariant: Output follows successful numeric option consumption.

release_pair.analysis: No destructor or free operation applies to this closequote scalar; process exit releases its image lifetime.
release_pair.invariant: Closing quote has no allocator or FD owner.
limitations: The byte is image state and never owns output FILE storage.

error_cleanup.analysis: pr_error terminates a missing-number closequote option without acquiring a quote allocation or transferring argv ownership.
error_cleanup.invariant: Numeric option error cannot leak quote storage.

signals_handoff.analysis: The helper is single-threaded and has no custom handler that changes closequote between output arguments.
signals_handoff.invariant: Current closing-quote writes precede output reads.
limitations: Private single-invocation helper state only; metachars heap ownership and lstrtol arithmetic remain separate pending entries.
